=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11188-11197 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhaustion, the resume gate requires the PR head to equal `validation_last_passed_sha`, and only mark_validation_complete (17544) writes that field, so any changed head is skipped as `reason=validation_not_recorded detail=head_moved` on every tick.
  WHY: Once the first auto-retry fails, the project stays parked even after a fix is pushed, yet the tracking comment (line 11268), changelog, README, agents fragment and issue requirement #4 all promise a retry "until the PR's head changes"; the only ways out are ai:force-merge, /judge_resume or a person (all reviewers rated it MAJOR).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15401-15403, 16042-16060, 17597-17605 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: On exhaustion, the failed callback (17605 → 16042-16060) releases the comprehensive-cycle freeze, sets `comprehensive_release_callback` handled/failed and removes `ai:comprehensive-test-pending`, so after auto-resume comprehensive_promotion_gate_before_final_merge (called at 14749) returns 0 straight away at 15401-15403, and the success callback returns early (15904/15909).
  WHY: A resumed comprehensive-cycle project merges into the default branch with no promotion gate, against the issue requirement that the retry keep "the comprehensive promotion gate"; the fail-closed fix is to skip when `.comprehensive_release_callback.status == "failed"` (all reviewers rated it MAJOR).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11140-11160, 17472-17477, 29673-29681 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `final_merge_exhausted` marker and the old `validation_last_passed_sha` survive /judge_resume (29673-29681) and later failures in mark_validation_failed (17404-17412, 17472), and the gate never checks `.validation_failure_reason`, so a stale marker can trigger an auto-resume.
  WHY: Exhaust → /judge_resume → terminal validation failure on the same head → the next tick passes every gate check, restores `ai:validated` and merges a head whose latest validation failed (all reviewers rated it MAJOR).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11247-11258 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the resume state write fails, the function returns 1 with no throttle or sentinel, so every tick re-runs the full gate, the PR/compare reads and the label changes (ai:validated at 11243, then ai:blocked restored at 11256).
  WHY: A transient or persistent write failure turns into a per-tick hot loop of API reads, label writes and repeated log lines, and no test covers this branch; severity disagreement: gemini and minimax rated it MAJOR, glm rated it NIT (fails closed, but the side effects repeat without bound).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11260 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `|| echo '["ai:validated"]'` fallback on the TRACKING_LABELS reassignment replaces the whole in-memory label array when jq fails, dropping labels such as `ai:comprehensive-test-pending`, `ai:force-merge` and `ai:integration-backpressure`.
  WHY: Gate decisions (15401, 14641) and label diffing for the rest of the tick then work from the wrong baseline; the fix is a one-line fallback that keeps the previous array (all reviewers rated it NIT).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11147-11150, 11192-11196 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The contractual `FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME outcome=skip` vocabulary gains a ninth reason, `validation_not_recorded`, which is not in the issue's enumerated set, and it covers two conditions: no validated SHA recorded, and a head that moved.
  WHY: Log tooling written against the issue's reason set will not recognise these lines, and the two conditions can only be told apart by `detail=`; the agents fragment documents the extra value, so this is a spec deviation (all reviewers rated it NIT).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11230, 29739-29747 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When a project is in both the force-merge path and the exhaustion path, compute_cycle_integration_ahead_by runs twice in one tick (force-merge block, then maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhaustion).
  WHY: It duplicates the default-branch and compare API reads, above the issue's per-tick API budget; glm notes this overlap only happens in the marker-survival case (project_is_validation_origin_terminal_failure, 11077-11089) (all reviewers rated it NIT).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:17631-17637 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The success write clears only `final_merge_failure_kind`, leaving `final_merge_failure_head_sha` set and never clearing the `final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas` ledger (append at 11252).
  WHY: Informational only, because the gate keys on the cleared marker, but stale per-head state stays on completed projects (bounded at 20 entries) (all reviewers rated it NIT).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11149, 11196 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `fmar_head_sha` is lowercased but `fmar_validated_sha` is read from state without normalisation before the comparison.
  WHY: A state file holding an upper-hex `validation_last_passed_sha` would always skip as `head_moved` and never auto-resume (rated NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Stop after one try per head SHA. Record each final-PR head SHA that has had an automatic retry. If the retry fails again, the project re-parks normally, and no further automatic retry happens until the PR's head changes."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhaustion (gate at 11194-11197), plus the comment at line 11268 and changelog.d/8984-final-merge-auto-resume.md
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No code path allows a retry on a changed head because of the gate at 11194, and the only changed-head handling is the skip branch at ~11195 (`reason=validation_not_recorded detail=head_moved`); validation_last_passed_sha is written only inside mark_validation_complete (17544); the failed-project path never dispatches validation or updates that SHA; test_final_merge_auto_resume_skip_reasons (tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py ~31978 / 31985-31989) asserts that a moved head is skipped; no test covers a retry after a head change
- requirement: "Stop after one try per head SHA ... If the retry fails again, the project re-parks normally, and no further automatic retry happens until the PR's head changes."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: No test covers a retry after a head change; existing tests and gates specifically block it.
- requirement: Issue Tests section: "Extend the existing poller tests …" and "Also run tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py."
  expected_change_site: the pre-push gate / CI run on the PR head (tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py, tests/test_orchestrate_poll_workflow_contract.py, tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py against .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The PR acceptance table marks the red-on-base tests "not run" and the workflow-contract and file-size rows "unmet", tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py timed out (Unverified), and all 21 CI check-runs on f3357aac were cancelled; sonnet notes CI runs shellcheck with `--severity=error` (.github/workflows/ci.yml:477-478) and no error-level construct could be pinned to the new lines
- requirement: Issue §"Tests": full coverage of the new resume path, with the new tests passing on the PR head
  expected_change_site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py new tests (lines ~31748-32037 / ~31813-32024), verified by the pre-push gate and CI on head f3357aac
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The acceptance table lists every red-on-base row as `not run`, tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py timed out (Unverified), and all 21 check-runs were cancelled, so scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh lines ~11121-11271 and ~29747-29759 have no passing test evidence; glm adds that the gate attributes 6 failures to this change (shellcheck, tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py, tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py, tests/test_session_start_extract_repo_slug.py, tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py) and says the shellcheck failure should be reproduced against scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11192-11197 (comment at 11268) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Only mark_validation_complete (17544-17545) writes `validation_last_passed_sha`; after a failed retry on head H, H skips as `already_resumed_on_head` and any new head H2 skips as `head_moved`, so no state lets a changed head through.
  WHY: The project stays parked after a fix is pushed, despite the comment, changelog, README and ledger promising a retry on a new head; keep the fail-closed behaviour and change the wording to say a new head needs `/revalidate` or a person.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:17605; 16042-16050, 16056; 15401-15403 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The failed callback releases the freeze, writes the callback as handled/failed and removes `ai:comprehensive-test-pending`, so after auto-resume the promotion gate (called at 14749) returns 0 at 15401, and the success callback at 17643 returns early at 15904.
  WHY: A verifying-role project merges with no promotion step and a proving-role project merges with no verifying run; fix: skip with `reason=lookup_failed detail=comprehensive_cycle_aborted` when `.comprehensive_release_callback.status == "failed"`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:29673-29681; 17472; 11140-11151 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `final_merge_exhausted` marker is cleared only at 11251 and 17634, so after /judge_resume it and the old `validation_last_passed_sha` survive later failures (17472, 24282, 34269), and the gate never checks `.validation_failure_reason`.
  WHY: The gate restores `ai:validated` and merges a head whose latest validation failed; fix: `.final_merge_failure_kind = null` in the /judge_resume jq at 29677, plus a skip when `validation_failure_reason` is set.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11260 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The jq-failure fallback `|| echo '["ai:validated"]'` drops every other tracking label.
  WHY: The mark_validation_complete call later in the same tick reads TRACKING_LABELS (15401, 14641), so gate decisions change.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11149, 11195 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Adds a ninth skip reason, `validation_not_recorded`, and uses it for two conditions.
  WHY: Log tooling written against the contractual set will not recognise it;
